title: Monadicity of generalized operadic algebras over color diagrams
statement: Use the universes and monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and presentability of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. A small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad is an inner fibration $\mathcal M\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ with cocartesian lifts of all inert arrows, Segal equivalences $\mathcal M_{[n]}\simeq\mathcal M_{[1]}\times_{\mathcal M_{[0]}}\cdots\times_{\mathcal M_{[0]}}\mathcal M_{[1]}$ (the zero-factor fiber product for $n=0$ is $\mathcal M_{[0]}$), and the following relative-limit axiom: write $I_n$ for the category of inert maps $\alpha:[n]\to[i]$, $i=0,1$, and commuting triangles of inert maps between their targets. For every $C\in\mathcal M_{[n]}$ choose its cocartesian inert projection diagram $C_\alpha$. For every $X\in\mathcal M_{[m]}$ and $\phi:[m]\to[n]$, the canonical map $\operatorname{Map}^{\phi}_{\mathcal M}(X,C)\to\lim_{\alpha\in I_n}\operatorname{Map}^{\alpha\phi}_{\mathcal M}(X,C_\alpha)$ is an equivalence. Here the superscript specifies the homotopy fiber of the map on mapping spaces over that base arrow. A base map is inert when opposite to inclusion of a consecutive subinterval; an edge of $\mathcal M$ is inert when it is cocartesian over such a base map. Assume $\mathcal M_{[0]}$ is Kan and $\mathcal V$ admits small colimits preserved separately by tensoring. Let $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$ be the full infinity category of inert-preserving functors $\mathcal M\to\mathcal V^\otimes$ over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, and let $U$ be restriction to $\mathcal M_{[1]}$. Then $U:\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V)$ has a coherent left adjoint $F$ and is monadic: the comparison to the infinity category of homotopy coherent algebras for the monad $UF$, whose unit and multiplication come from $F\dashv U$, is an equivalence over $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V)$. Moreover $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$ has all small sifted colimits and $U$ preserves them. Sifted means that colimits of spaces indexed by the shape commute with finite products; this includes geometric realizations indexed by $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$. No presentability of $\mathcal V$ is required.

proof.text: Form $\tau:\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}\to\mathcal M$. By [lem-coef-inert-operad-color-reconstruction] this is a map of small generalized operads, identity on the Kan zero-fiber, and $E:\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}}(\mathcal V)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V)$ identifies $E\tau^*$ with $U$. This uses the actual coherent equivalence on the inert diagrams, not just a correspondence on objects.

source.place: Supporting operadic foundation: Gepner–Haugseng Definition 3.4.1 and Proposition 3.4.5, pp.615–616; online source https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/gepner-haugseng2.pdf

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-generalized-active-extension-criterion] to $u=\tau$. Each active slice $K_c$ is small, since both operads are small. Every diagram $D_{A,c}$ therefore has a colimit in $\mathcal V$. Tensoring on the left and right preserves this colimit by the hypotheses, and their composite $L\otimes(-)\otimes R$ does so too. All zero-fiber hypotheses were verified in step 1. Obtain $\tau_!\dashv\tau^*$, with natural mapping-space adjunction. Thus $F=\tau_!E^{-1}$ is left adjoint to $U$, with the transported coherent unit and counit.

source.place: Supporting operadic foundation: Gepner–Haugseng Propositions A.4.3–A.4.4, Corollary A.4.5 and Theorem A.4.6, pp.705–706; online source https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/gepner-haugseng2.pdf

proof.text: Fix a small sifted shape $K$. By [lem-coef-infinity-sifted-colimit-calculus] it is weakly contractible and separately colimit-preserving tensor products preserve $K$-colimits jointly. Inducting on the number of factors gives this for every positive finite tensor product. A zero-fold tensor is constant at $\mathbf1$; its $K$-colimit is $\mathbf1$ by the weakly contractible constant-diagram assertion of [lem-coef-infinity-coslice-colimit-formula]. Under the Segal equivalences of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], every fiber $\mathcal V^\otimes_{[n]}\simeq\mathcal V^n$ has $K$-colimits componentwise. Transport along a base map $[n]\to[m]$ opposite to $f:[m]\to[n]$ has as its $j$th output the tensor of entries $f(j-1)+1,\ldots,f(j)$: factor the map into an inert restriction to the chosen subinterval and an endpoint-preserving active map, then use the tensor transport in the monoidal definition. If the endpoints coincide the output is the empty tensor. The preceding calculation proves that every such transport preserves $K$-colimits, including all empty-block and $[0]$ cases.

source.place: Supporting operadic foundation: Gepner–Haugseng Lemma A.5.1 and proof of Corollary A.5.4, pp.707–709; online source https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/gepner-haugseng2.pdf

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-cocartesian-section-colimits] to $\mathcal V^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, $T=\mathcal M$, and $g=p$. Step 3 verifies its fiber-colimit, transport-preservation and weak-contractibility hypotheses. Take its specified edge set $H$ to be the inert cocartesian edges of $\mathcal M$. The full subcategory carrying $H$ to cocartesian edges is precisely $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal V)$, so it is closed under these section-category colimits. A colimit in a full subcategory closed under ambient colimits satisfies the same universal mapping-space property. Evaluation at every color therefore sends these colimits to colimits in $\mathcal V$. Colimits in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V)$ are also pointwise: apply the same section lemma to the product cocartesian fibration $\mathcal M_{[1]}\times\mathcal V\to\mathcal M_{[1]}$ with identity transports. Thus $U$ preserves all small sifted colimits.

source.place: Supporting operadic foundation: Gepner–Haugseng Theorem A.5.3 and Corollary A.5.4, pp.708–709; online source https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/gepner-haugseng2.pdf

proof.text: To show $U$ conservative, let $h:A\to B$ be an algebra transformation whose restriction to colors is an equivalence. The vertexwise criterion in [lem-cbc-enhanced-functor-cone-calculus] makes every color component an equivalence. For $x\in\mathcal M_{[n]}$, naturality with the chosen inert projections identifies $h_x$ under the monoidal Segal equivalence with the tuple $(h_{x_1},\ldots,h_{x_n})$, so it is an equivalence; for $n=0$ the target fiber is terminal and the same assertion holds for the empty tuple. Apply [lem-coef-infinity-pointwise-cocartesian-transport] to $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M,\mathcal V^\otimes)\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M,\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$. A vertical transformation with equivalence components has cocartesian components over identities, hence is cocartesian in this functor fibration and is an equivalence in its fiber: its cocartesian mapping-space property over an identity makes precomposition an equivalence for every target; lifting the identity of the source gives a right inverse, and injectivity up to homotopy with target the target gives the other inverse identity. This fiber is the section category. Its full algebra subcategory reflects equivalences, so $h$ is an equivalence of algebras.

source.place: Supporting operadic foundation: Gepner–Haugseng Lemma A.5.5, p.709; online source https://www.sas.rochester.edu/mth/sites/doug-ravenel/otherpapers/gepner-haugseng2.pdf

proof.text: The simplex shape $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ is sifted by [lem-coef-infinity-sifted-colimit-calculus]. Hence step 4 gives geometric realizations in the algebra category and preservation by $U$; step 5 gives conservativity, and step 2 supplies $F\dashv U$. Apply [lem-coef-infinity-monadic-bar] to this adjunction. Its coherent comparison is an equivalence over the color-diagram category to algebras for $UF$, with unit the adjunction unit and multiplication $U\epsilon F$. These are exactly the monad and comparison asserted in the item. Every step used only small colimits and separate tensor preservation, so no presentability of $\mathcal V$ has entered.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NM-179a3165d (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, both new nodes and every cited statement in full. I could not open the Gepner-Haugseng source: it is not in literature/ and reviewers have no network. The source stays WANTED and proof_origin is agent, so the steps were checked directly against the cited DAG statements instead. Item statement: unchanged and not weakened (Kan zero-fiber, small colimits preserved separately by tensor, no presentability). Step 1: U equals E after tau^* exactly, since the [1]-fiber of M_triv is M_[1]. Step 2: all of the criterion's hypotheses hold for tau (small K_c, colimits exist, L⊗-⊗R preserves them, the zero-fiber conditions hold), and F = tau_! E^{-1}. Step 3: the sifted-calculus and coslice nodes say what the step uses, and the n=0 and empty-block cases are covered. Step 4: the hypotheses of the cocartesian-section lemma hold; with H = inert edges the subcategory is exactly Alg, and colimits in Fun(M_[1],V) are pointwise. Step 5: equivalences are detected through the Segal equivalence, and the cocartesian-over-identity argument uses the pointwise-transport statement; the tool use of lem-cbc-enhanced-functor-cone-calculus is accepted. Step 6: the monadic-bar hypotheses are met. New node 1 (reconstruction): I checked myself that M_triv is a generalized operad (inner fibration, inert lifts stay cocartesian, relative-limit axiom holds for non-inert phi), and tested it on M=Delta^op and empty M. New node 2 (active-extension criterion): tested with u=id and with A_[1] empty, and the extra zero-fiber hypotheses only make it weaker. Duplicates: the existing candidates (cocomplete-extensions, free-cocone-criterion, active-slice-formula, colorwise-sifted-colimits) all reach the item through lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability, so citing them would make a cycle. The ordinary-operad criterion does not cover generalized operads; the new criterion generalizes it, a merge candidate for later. No cycle after the delivery, no SGA, no fixes made.
